# New renderings chosen in iliad-076 (Iliad 12.378–471)

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| ἑλίσσω (ἑλιξάμενος, 12.408, 12.467) | "turning himself about" | "turning round" | "wheeling", "twisting"; the table has ἑλιχθέντων "having been wheeled round" (12.74) for the passive; the middle is the leader turning to face his men |
| μάρμαρος · ὀκριόεις (μαρμάρῳ ὀκριόεντι, 12.380) | "rock" · "jagged" | "rock" · "jagged" | "marble" (the later sense), "boulder", "rugged"; the note says μάρμαρος is any rock |
| ὑπέρτατος (12.381, of the stone on top) | "uppermost" | "uppermost" | "topmost", "highest"; superlative of ὕπερ |
| ἡβῶν (οὐδὲ μάλ’ ἡβῶν, 12.382) | "quite in youthful prime" | "fully in youthful prime" | "young", "in his youth", "in his prime" (the table’s ἡβῷμ’, 7.133, avoids "in my prime"; ἡβώοντα, 9.446, has "youthful prime"); ἡβάω "be in youthful prime" |
| τετράφαλος (τετράφαλον κυνέην, 12.384) | "four-ridged" | "four-ridged" | "four-crested", "four-plated"; follows τετραφάληρον "four-ridged" (5.743), with the note that φάλος is not certain |
| ἄραξε · θλάσσε (σὺν δ’ ὀστέ’ ἄραξε, θλάσσε δὲ κυνέην, 12.384) | "crushed" · "smashed" | "crushed" · "smashed" | "dashed", "broke"; ἄραξε keeps "crushed" of the Odyssey’s same words (odyssey-061); θλάσσε needed a second word, "smashed" |
| κάππεσ’ (12.386) | "fell down" | "tumbled" | "fell"; follows the Odyssey’s κάππεσ’ ἀπ’ ἰκριόφιν "tumbled" in `i` |
| ἀρνευτήρ (ἀρνευτῆρι ἐοικώς, 12.385) | "diver" | "diver" | not new: the Odyssey’s "diver" (odyssey-061) |
| ἐπεσσύμενος (12.388) | "rushed on" | "rushed at" | "darting at", "hurrying on"; ἐπισεύομαι "rush at", the genitive τείχεος read as the goal |
| εὐχετάομαι (εὐχετόῳτ’, 12.391) | "boast over" | "boast over" | "vaunt", "exult"; the optative of purpose after a past verb |
| χάρμη (παῦσε δὲ χάρμης, λήθετο χάρμης, 12.389, 12.393) | "the joy of battle" | "the joy of battle" | not new: the table’s χάρμης (4.222, 4.509); in `i` of 12.389 "put an end to his joy of battle" |
| στιβαρός (χερσὶ στιβαρῇσιν, 12.397) | "stout" | "stout" | "sturdy" (reserved for ἄλκιμος); not new: the table’s στιβαρός "stout" |
| ἑταῖρος (Σαρπήδοντος ἑταῖρον, 12.379) | "companion" | "companion" | not new: the table’s "companion" |
| ὁμαρτέω (ὁμαρτήσανθ’, 12.400) | "going together" | "went at him together" | "meeting", "following"; follows the table’s ὁμαρτέω "going together" (21.188) |
| τελαμών (12.401) | "strap" | "shield-strap" | "baldric", "belt", "sling"; the table’s τελαμών (2.388) "strap" / "shield-strap" with ἀσπίδος ἀμφιβρότης |
| ἀμφιβρότης (ἀσπίδος ἀμφιβρότης, 12.402) | "man-covering" | "man-covering" | not new: the table’s ἀσπίδος ἀμφιβρότης (2.389) |
| κῆρας ἄμυνε (12.402) | "warded off the death-fates" | "kept the fates of death away" | "doom", "death"; the table’s κῆρας ἀμύνει (4.11), with the past tense |
| ἐπάλμενος (ἐπάλμενος, 12.404) | "springing upon him" | "springing at him" | "leaping on", "charging"; aorist participle of ἐφάλλομαι |
| ἐγχείη … στυφέλιξε (ἤλυθεν ἐγχείη, στυφέλιξε δέ μιν μεμαῶτα, 12.405) | "went the spear, and thrust him roughly, eager as he was" | "it shoved him, eager as he was" | the published English of the same line in iliad-043 (7.261), reused; only the sentence round it changes (the spear did not go through) |
| ἔπαλξις (12.397, 12.406) | "battlement" | "battlement" | "parapet", "breastwork"; not new: the shipped "battlement" (iliad-074, iliad-075) |
| κέκλετο (κέκλετο δ’ ἀντιθέοισιν ἑλιξάμενος Λυκίοισιν, 12.408; 12.467) | "gave orders to" | "gave orders to" | "called to", "urged"; the table’s κέκλετο "gave orders to", kept although 12.408 introduces an appeal |
| μεθίημι (μεθίετε θούριδος ἀλκῆς, 12.409) | "slacken from" | "slacken from" | "let go of", "give up", "abandon"; the genitive is "from" |
| ὁμοκλήν (ἄνακτος … ὁμοκλήν, 12.413) | "rebuke" | "shouted rebuke" | the table’s ὁμοκλή "rebuke" / "shouted rebuke" (6.137), kept |
| βουληφόρον ἄνακτα (12.414) | "counsel-bearing lord" | "the lord who bears counsel" | "counsellor lord", "wise lord"; follows βουληφόρον ἄνδρα (2.24) "a man who bears counsel" and βουληφόρε (5.180) "counsel-bearer" |
| ἐπιβρίθω (ἐπέβρισαν, 12.414) | "pressed on" | "pressed in" | "bore down on" (kept for ἐπιβρίσῃ, 5.91), "crowded"; with μᾶλλον "the harder" |
| ἐκαρτύναντο φάλαγγας (12.415, in a longer unit) | "made strong their battle-lines" | "strengthened their battle-lines" | the published English of the same line in iliad-065 (11.215), reused |
| ἔργον (μέγα … ἔργον, 12.416) | "work" | "task" | "deed", "labour"; the work of holding the wall |
| ἴφθιμοι Λύκιοι · αἰχμηταὶ Δαναοί (12.417, 12.419) | "mighty Lycians" · "spearmen Danaans" | "the mighty Lycians" · "the Danaan spearmen" | "warlike", "strong"; the table’s ἴφθιμος "mighty" and αἰχμητής "spearmen" |
| ὤσασθαι (ἂψ ὤσασθαι, 12.420) | "thrust back" | "push back" | "drive back" (reserved for ἐλαύνω), "repel"; the table’s ὠθέω l "thrust", i "push" (2.744) |
| οὖρος (ἀμφ’ οὔροισι, 12.421) | "boundary-marks" | "boundary-marks" | "boundary-stones", "landmarks", "fences"; οὖρος = ὅρος, the thing that marks a boundary |
| μέτρα (μέτρ’ ἐν χερσὶν ἔχοντες, 12.422) | "measures" | "measures" | "measuring-rods" (a guess at the thing, not said by the Greek), "yardsticks"; the note says rods are probable |
| ἐπίξυνος ἄρουρα (ἐπιξύνῳ ἐν ἀρούρῃ, 12.422) | "common plough-land" | "plough-land they share" | "common field", "shared acre"; ἄρουρα "plough-land" is the table’s |
| ἴση (περὶ ἴσης, 12.423) | "an equal share" | "an equal share" | "a fair line", "the boundary"; ἴση "equal share" |
| διείργω (διέεργον, 12.424) | "kept apart" | "kept apart" | "separated", "divided"; follows ἀνέεργε "held back" (3.77) with δια- "apart" |
| δηϊόω (δῄουν, 12.425) | "hacking at" | "hacked at" | "cutting down"; the published English of the same lines in iliad-031 (5.452–453), reused |
| οὐτάζω κατὰ χρόα (12.427) | "wounded in the flesh" | "wounded in the flesh" | "pierced along the skin", "grazed"; οὐτάζω "wound" |
| μετάφρενον (12.428) | "back" | "backs" | "shoulder-blades", "spine"; the part between the shoulders |
| ῥαίνω (ἐρράδατ’, 12.431) | "were spattered" | "were spattered" | "sprinkled", "drenched", "stained"; perfect passive |
| φόβον ποιῆσαι (12.432) | "cause flight" | "put to flight" | "cause fear", "make panic"; φόβος "flight, rout" |
| χερνῆτις ἀληθής (12.433) | "an honest worker with her hands" | "an honest woman who works with her hands" | "poor widow", "spinner", "true"; χερνῆτις is one who earns with her hands, ἀληθής "honest" (does not cheat the scales) |
| τάλαντα (12.433) | "scales" | "scales" | "balance", "weights"; plural noun "scales" |
| σταθμός (12.434) | "weight" | "weight" | "beam", "balance-beam", "plummet"; the note says the sense may be the beam |
| ἀεικέα μισθόν (12.435) | "unseemly wage" | "unseemly wage" | "meagre", "poor", "miserable"; the table’s ἀεικής "unseemly" (1.341, 2.264); the note says the wage is too small to be fitting |
| ἄρηται (12.435) | "win" | "win" | "earn", "carry off"; ἄρνυμαι, as ἀρέσθαι "win" (12.407) |
| ἐπὶ ἶσα (12.436) | "equally" | "evenly" | "on equal terms", "in equal measure"; ἶσα "equal" |
| τείνω (μάχη τέτατο, 12.436) | "was stretched" | "were stretched out" | "was drawn out", "raged"; the verb "stretch"; μάχη keeps the table’s "fighting" in both layers (not "fight", "battle") |
| κῦδος ὑπέρτερον (12.437) | "greater glory" | "greater glory" | "higher glory", "superior fame"; κῦδος is "glory" (the table’s) and ὑπέρτερος the comparative of ὕπερ |
| ἐσάλλομαι (ἐσήλατο τεῖχος, ἐσᾶλτο πύλας, 12.438, 12.466; ἔσθορε, 12.462) | "leapt in at" | "leapt in at" | "leapt over", "sprang upon" (each decides where), "stormed"; accusative of the place entered |
| ἤϋσεν … διαπρύσιον … γεγωνώς (12.439) | "shouted piercingly, calling aloud" | "shouted piercingly, calling aloud" | "cried loudly", "bellowed", "shrilly"; διαπρύσιον "piercing, far-carrying"; γέγωνα "call aloud" |
| ἱππόδαμοι Τρῶες (12.440) | "horse-taming Trojans" | "Trojans, tamers of horses" | the table’s ἱππόδαμοι / ἱπποδάμων (3.127) |
| ῥήγνυμι (ῥήγνυσθε τεῖχος, 12.440) | "break" | "break through" | "tear down", "smash"; the middle imperative |
| ἐνίημι (ἐνίετε πῦρ, 12.441) | "cast upon" | "throw on" | "send in", "hurl"; ἐνίημι "throw on" (fire on the ships) |
| θεσπιδαὲς πῦρ (12.441) | "wondrous-blazing fire" | "wondrous-blazing fire" | "divine fire", "prodigious flame"; the Odyssey table’s θεσπιδαὲς πῦρ, unchanged |
| οὔασι ἄκουον (12.442) | "with their ears listened" | "listened with their ears" | "heard" alone (drops οὔασι); the plain Homeric phrase is kept |
| ἀολλέες (12.443) | "all together" | "in a body" | "in a throng" (kept for ὅμιλος), "massed", "in a crowd" |
| κρόσσαι (κροσσάων, 12.444) | "stepped ledges" | "stepped ledges" | "battlements" (kept for ἐπάλξεις), "parapets"; follows the shipped κρόσσας "stepped ledges" (iliad-074) |
| ἀκαχμένος (ἀκαχμένα δούρατ’, 12.444) | "pointed" | "pointed" | "sharpened", "whetted", "tipped"; perfect participle of the root ἀκ- "sharp" |
| λᾶας (12.445) | "stone" | "stone" | "rock" (kept for μάρμαρος), "boulder"; λίθος is also "stone" (12.459), the poet using both for the same thing |
| πρυμνὸς παχύς · ὀξύς (12.446–447) | "thick at the base" · "sharp" | "thick at its base" · "sharp" | "stout" (kept for στιβαρός), "broad"; πρυμνός "at the bottom, at the base" |
| ὀχλίζω (ὀχλίσσειαν, 12.448) | "heave up" | "heave" | "lever up", "lift"; the epic σσ spelling |
| ἐλαφρός (12.450) | "light" | "light" | "weightless", "nimble"; not new |
| ἄρσενος οἰός (12.451) | "male sheep" | "ram" | "he-sheep"; ἄρσην "male" |
| χειρὶ … ἑτέρῃ (12.452) | "in one hand" | "in one hand" | "in the other hand", "in his free hand"; ἕτερος "one of two", the other hand being free |
| ἰθύς (ἰθὺς σανίδων, 12.453) | "straight at" | "straight at" | "right toward", "directly"; ἰθύς "straight" with the genitive of the doors |
| σανίς (σανίδων, 12.453; σανίδες, 12.461) | "doors" | "doors" | "boards", "planks", "door-leaves"; follows the Odyssey table’s σανίδες "doors" (12.121) |
| εἴρυντο πύλας (12.454) | "guarded the gates" | "guarded the gates" | "kept", "protected", "closed"; ἐρύομαι "guard", apart from ἐρύω "haul" |
| ἀραρυῖα (ἀραρυίας, 12.454) | "fitted" | "fitted together" | "joined", "set"; follows the table’s ἀραρυῖα "fitted" |
| δικλίς (δικλίδας ὑψηλάς, 12.455) | "two-leaved" | "two-leaved" | "folding", "double", "double-doored"; δι- "two" + κλίς, the note says each gate has two doors |
| ὀχεύς (ὀχῆες, 12.455) | "bars" | "bars" | "bolts" (kept for κληΐς), "clasps" (the Odyssey’s ὀχῆες χρύσειοι); follows the table’s ὀχεύς "bar" (12.121) |
| ἐπημοιβός (ἐπημοιβοί, 12.456) | "crossing each other" | "crossing one another" | "alternating", "interlocking", "sliding"; rare word, the note says the sense is a guess |
| κληΐς (κληῒς ἐπαρήρει, 12.456) | "bolt" | "bolt" | "key", "bar" (kept for ὀχεύς); follows the Odyssey table’s κληΐς of a door-fastening "bolt" (21.241) |
| ἐπαραρίσκω (ἐπαρήρει, 12.456) | "was fitted over" | "was fitted over" | "lay across", "held fast"; pluperfect with an imperfect’s sense |
| ἐρείδομαι (ἐρεισάμενος, 12.457) | "bracing himself" | "bracing himself" | "leaning", "setting his weight"; aorist middle participle |
| εὖ διαβάς (12.458) | "standing well astride" | "standing well astride" | "with legs apart", "firm-footed"; διαβαίνω "stride apart" |
| ἀφαυρός (ἀφαυρότερον, 12.458) | "weaker" | "weaker" | "feebler", "slighter"; comparative |
| βέλος (12.458, of the stone) | "missile" | "missile" | "weapon", "shot"; whatever is thrown |
| θαιρός (θαιρούς, 12.459) | "hinges" | "hinges" | "posts", "door-pivots", "jambs"; rare word, the note says "hinges" is the usual sense |
| βριθοσύνη (βριθοσύνῃ, 12.460) | "by its weight" | "by its weight" | "heaviness", "its burden"; dative of βρίθω "be heavy" |
| μυκάομαι (πύλαι μύκον, 12.460) | "bellowed" | "bellowed" | "groaned", "roared", "lowed"; the verb is said of cattle, here of gates |
| ἄλλυδις ἄλλη (12.461) | "one this way, one that" | "one this way and one that" | "in all directions", "far and wide"; each door goes its own way |
| ῥιπή (λᾶος ὑπὸ ῥιπῆς, 12.462) | "rush" | "rush" | "force", "swing", "blow"; ῥιπή "rush, force of a throw" |
| νυκτὶ θοῇ ἀτάλαντος ὑπώπια (12.463) | "the equal of swift night in his looks" | "the equal of swift night in his looks" | "like night", "dark as night" (each adds to the Greek), "in his face"; ἀτάλαντος "equal" as in ἀτάλαντος Ἄρηϊ (2.627), ὑπώπια "looks" |
| σμερδαλέος (χαλκῷ σμερδαλέῳ, 12.464) | "frightful" | "frightful" | "terrible", "dreadful", "awful"; the table’s σμερδαλέος "frightful" (5.742) |
| ἕεστο περὶ χροΐ (12.464) | "wore about his skin" | "wore on his body" | "was clothed in", "had on"; ἕννυμι "wear" |
| δοιὰ δοῦρα (12.464–465) | "two spears" | "two spears" | "twin spears", "a pair"; the table’s δοιά "two" |
| οὔ κέν τίς … ἐρύκακεν (12.465) | "no one could have held him back" | "no one … could have held him back" | "would have held", "could hold"; κεν with an aorist for a past possibility; follows the table’s ἐρύκω "hold back" |
| νόσφι θεῶν (12.466) | "except gods" | "except the gods" | "far from the gods", "without the gods"; νόσφι + genitive "apart from" |
| πυρὶ δ’ ὄσσε δεδήει (12.466) | "with fire his two eyes were ablaze" | "his eyes blazed with fire" | "burned", "flamed"; follows the table’s δεδήει "was ablaze" / "blazed" (12.35) |
| ὅμιλος (καθ’ ὅμιλον, 12.467) | "throng" | "throng" | "crowd", "company"; not new |
| ὑπερβαίνω (τεῖχος ὑπερβαίνειν, 12.468; ὑπέρβασαν, 12.469) | "go over" | "go over" · "went over" | "cross", "scale", "climb over"; the wall is stepped over |
| ποιητός (ποιητὰς … πύλας, 12.470) | "well-made" | "well-made" | "wrought", "built"; ποιητός "well-made" with αὐτάς "the very" |
| ἐσχέω (ἐσέχυντο, 12.470) | "poured in" | "poured in" | "flooded", "streamed in"; aorist middle |
| φοβέομαι (φόβηθεν, 12.470) | "were put to flight" | "fled" | "were terrified", "panicked"; aorist passive, as in φόβον ποιῆσαι "cause flight" |
| ὅμαδος ἀλίαστος (12.471) | "an uproar, relentless" | "a relentless uproar" | "din", "unceasing clamour", "noisy crowd" (the shipped sense at 7.307); ὅμαδος "uproar" (9.573), ἀλίαστος "relentless" (2.797) |
| ἐτύχθη (12.471) | "was made" | "arose" | "was wrought", "broke out"; aorist passive of τεύχω |
